#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Native synthetic .fwsc test vectors: no vendor SDK, no flashable code."""

import json
from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT/'tools'))
from fm1pkg_make import ufw
from firmware_build_labels import canonical_version, inspect_package, version_of_product

SHA = '0123456789abcdef' * 2 + '01234567'


class FirmwareBuildLabelsTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.work = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.work.cleanup)
        self.path = Path(self.work.name) / 'test.fwsc'

    def make_package(self, product):
        # Fake application and loader have a valid transport envelope but are
        # not real firmware; only the model/version framing is exercised.
        self.path.write_bytes(ufw(b'\0'*1024, b'FELUCCA-LOADER-1'+b'\0'*128, product))

    def test_version_encoded_in_real_package_identity(self):
        self.make_package('SMK-37 Elite_9000702')
        result = inspect_package(self.path, 'elite', SHA, expected_version='0.7.2')
        self.assertEqual(result['firmware_version'], '0.7.2')
        self.assertEqual(result['release_display'], '0.7.2_openbeta')
        self.assertNotIn('openbeta', result['product'])
        self.assertEqual(result['version_label'], 'v0.7.2')
        self.assertEqual(result['source_commit'], SHA)
        self.assertEqual(result['package_sha256'], __import__('hashlib').sha256(self.path.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
        self.assertTrue(result['build_id'].startswith('g0123456789ab-h'))
        self.assertFalse(result['device_tested'])
        self.assertFalse(result['installable'])
        self.assertEqual(result['status'], 'package-inspected')

    def test_unversioned_legacy_cannot_get_fake_semver(self):
        for product in ('SMK-37 Pro_900', 'SMK-37 Elite_900', 'MKE-P37_900', 'FM-1_906'):
            with self.subTest(product=product):
                model = {'SMK-37 Pro': 'pro', 'SMK-37 Elite': 'elite', 'MKE-P37': 'mke', 'FM-1': 'fm1'}[product.split('_')[0]]
                self.make_package(product)
                result = inspect_package(self.path, model, SHA)
                self.assertIsNone(result['firmware_version'])
                self.assertIn('Unversioned', result['display_label'])
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'no numeric version'):
                    inspect_package(self.path, model, SHA, '0.7.2')

    def test_wrong_model_version_and_forged_commit_rejected(self):
        self.make_package('SMK-37 Elite_9000702')
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'model does not match'):
            inspect_package(self.path, 'pro', SHA)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'expected firmware'):
            inspect_package(self.path, 'elite', SHA, '0.7.3')
        for bad in ('1234567', 'g' * 40, SHA.upper()):
            with self.subTest(commit=bad), self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, '40-character'):
                inspect_package(self.path, 'elite', bad)

    def test_bad_package_crc_loader_and_truncation_rejected(self):
        self.make_package('SMK-37 Pro_9010203')
        raw = bytearray(self.path.read_bytes())
        raw[-1] ^= 1
        self.path.write_bytes(raw)
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'integrity error'):
            inspect_package(self.path, 'pro', SHA)
        self.path.write_bytes(b'no firmware')
        with self.assertRaises(Exception):
            inspect_package(self.path, 'pro', SHA)
        self.make_package('SMK-37 Pro_9010203')
        self.path.write_bytes(self.path.read_bytes().replace(b'FELUCCA-LOADER-1', b'NO-UPDATE-LOADER'))
        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, 'update-loader'):
            inspect_package(self.path, 'pro', SHA)

    def test_canonical_semver_and_identity_bounds(self):
        for candidate in ('01.2.3', '1.02.3', '1.2', '1.2.3-beta', '100.0.0', '-1.0.0', '0.7.2_openbeta'):
            with self.subTest(version=candidate), self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                canonical_version(candidate)
        self.assertEqual(version_of_product('SMK-37 Elite_9999999', 'elite'), '99.99.99')
        self.assertEqual(version_of_product('FM-1_9000600', 'fm1'), '0.6.0')
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            version_of_product('SMK-37 Elite_9abc', 'elite')
        for malformed in (None, 900, {"product": "SMK-37 Elite_900"}):
            with self.subTest(product=malformed):
                with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "text"):
                    version_of_product(malformed, "elite")

    def test_cli_output_and_mismatch_do_not_write_output(self):
        self.make_package('SMK-37 Pro_9000702')
        dest = Path(self.work.name) / 'record.json'
        argv = [sys.executable, str(ROOT/'tools/firmware_build_labels.py'), str(self.path),
                '--model', 'pro', '--source-commit', SHA, '--expected-version', '0.7.2', '--out', str(dest)]
        r = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(r.returncode, 0, r.stderr)
        self.assertEqual(json.loads(dest.read_text())['firmware_version'], '0.7.2')
        dest.unlink()
        bad_argv = argv.copy()
        bad_argv[bad_argv.index('--expected-version') + 1] = '0.7.3'
        bad = subprocess.run(bad_argv,
                             capture_output=True, text=True)
        self.assertEqual(bad.returncode, 3)
        self.assertFalse(dest.exists())


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Fail-closed file backup tests; mocks filesystem faults, never accesses hardware."""
import importlib.util
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys
import tempfile
import unittest
from unittest import mock

source_path = Path(sys.argv.pop(1)) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1] / "tools" / "x0x_slots.py"
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("x0x_slots_under_test", source_path)
slots = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(slots)


class BackupAtomicTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.td = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory()
        self.addCleanup(self.td.cleanup)
        self.root = Path(self.td.name)
        self.dest = self.root / "samples.x0xslots"
        lay = {"count": 1, "size": 81920, "slots": [{"size": 81920, "nz": 0, "off": None}]}
        self.original = slots.make_archive(lay, [None], "2026-10-22T00:00:00Z")
        self.replacement = slots.make_archive(lay, [None], "2026-10-23T00:00:00Z")
        self.assertNotEqual(self.original, self.replacement)
        slots.read_archive(self.original)
        slots.read_archive(self.replacement)

    def assert_no_stage(self):
        self.assertEqual(list(self.root.glob(".samples.x0xslots.*.tmp")), [])

    def test_new_archive_valid_and_private(self):
        slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.replacement)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.stat().st_mode & 0o777, 0o600)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_force_atomically_replaces_existing_archive(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.replacement)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_default_does_not_overwrite_archive(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
            slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_fsync_failure_preserves_archive(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "fsync", side_effect=OSError("simulated fsync failure")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "simulated fsync"):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_replace_failure_preserves_archive(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "replace", side_effect=OSError("simulated rename failure")):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "simulated rename"):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_concurrent_creator_wins_without_force(self):
        def concurrent(*args):
            self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
            raise FileExistsError("raced with another backup")
        with mock.patch.object(slots.os, "link", side_effect=concurrent):
            with self.assertRaises(FileExistsError):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_invalid_archive_cannot_replace_good_backup(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        with self.assertRaises(slots.SlotError):
            slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement[:-4] + b"bad!", replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_temporary_readback_mismatch_preserves_backup(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        read = Path.read_bytes
        def tampered(p):
            v = read(p)
            return b"tampered" if p.name.startswith(".samples.x0xslots.") else v
        with mock.patch.object(Path, "read_bytes", tampered):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(slots.SlotError, "failed readback"):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_symlink_destination_does_not_modify_target(self):
        target = self.root / "other-valid-backup.x0xslots"
        target.write_bytes(self.original)
        self.dest.symlink_to(target)
        slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(target.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assertFalse(self.dest.is_symlink())
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.replacement)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_cli_force_does_not_truncate_on_disk_full(self):
        """The original main() calls Path.write_bytes, which corrupts the old archive."""
        import types
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        lay = {"count": 1, "size": 81920, "slots": [{"size": 81920, "nz": 0, "off": None}]}
        with mock.patch.dict(sys.modules, {"fm1_sample_upload": types.SimpleNamespace(Link=lambda: object())}), \
             mock.patch.object(slots, "backup", return_value=(lay, [None])), \
             mock.patch.object(slots, "make_archive", return_value=self.replacement):
            old_write = Path.write_bytes
            def broken_write(p, data):
                # Only the pre-fix direct destination overwrite uses this operation.
                with p.open("wb") as fd:
                    fd.write(data[:len(data)//2])
                raise OSError("simulated disk full writing destination")
            with mock.patch.object(Path, "write_bytes", broken_write):
                try:
                    slots.main(["backup", str(self.dest), "--force"])
                except OSError:
                    pass  # The old source failed after truncating the destination.
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.replacement)
        self.assert_no_stage()

    def test_partial_write_preserves_original(self):
        self.dest.write_bytes(self.original)
        original_named = slots.tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile
        def partial_writer(*args, **kwargs):
            f = original_named(*args, **kwargs)
            real_write = f.write
            def partial(b):
                real_write(b[:max(1, len(b) // 2)])
                raise OSError("simulated disk full during write")
            f.write = partial
            return f
        with mock.patch.object(slots.tempfile, "NamedTemporaryFile", side_effect=partial_writer):
            with self.assertRaisesRegex(OSError, "simulated disk full"):
                slots.save_backup_archive(self.dest, self.replacement, replace=True)
        self.assertEqual(self.dest.read_bytes(), self.original)
        self.assert_no_stage()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=2)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-3.0-only
"""Producer-side real BREAK regression for a checkpoint-aligned reverse-seek fast exit.

Reconstructs the exact unmodified PR93 parent DSP source by removing ONLY the
reviewed branch body, validating its Git blob against the actual remote parent.
The paired sources compile against identical verified dependencies and existing
production-linked host tests. Neither the test nor its timing certifies MCU ISR.
"""
import argparse
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
import time

SOURCE = 'firmware/src/dsp/breaks.c'
PARENT_BLOB = '9e1e607e2ddc3028383bfb6ebc85fbc7ac6864c5'
CHANGED_BLOB = '01e0e759d2b8be3b028e0e25d4f93348a36aeb46'
PINS = {
    'firmware/src/dsp/breaks.h': '6cb71d336c2c90fdc60a9594c2356f3a4379c264',
    'firmware/src/dsp/ima_adpcm.h': '9ba16e4fe9f0cb643c95a68d540042ab2581d4de',
    'firmware/src/dsp/fastmath.h': '7d2e41bf70590bafa8af0a7376bb912bf763b098',
    'firmware/src/dsp/x0x_param.h': 'f7c9bf22b0606946905790dc20497a2e4b2cb4a6',
    'firmware/src/seq/pattern.h': '9a0703418aae95b14f1b70905cfac916da38d7dd',
    'tests/host/breaks_reverse_fast_advance_test.c': '5e77b152253422d36ab7218669187d02318d21cb',
    'tests/host/breaks_live_stress_test.c': '1df9b9920f87ba08d05897a9e4684f85c85c90a4',
}
BENCH = 'tests/host/breaks_aligned_reverse_seek_benchmark.c'
PR28_HEADER = 'a5c26c95cad0d91a548a8db073f59777e36d4e86'
INSERTED = '''    /* rev_fetch passes a BRK_RCH-aligned base. If it is also an exact
     * checkpoint, no decoding or adjacent-state lookup is necessary. */
    if (i == p) {
        v->seek_pos = UINT32_MAX;
        return;
    }
'''


def blob(b):
    return hashlib.sha1(b'blob ' + str(len(b)).encode() + b'\0' + b).hexdigest()


def sha(b):
    return hashlib.sha256(b).hexdigest()


def run(argv, log, timeout=90, env=None):
    p = subprocess.run(argv, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=timeout,
                       check=False, env=env)
    log.write_text('$ ' + ' '.join(map(str, argv)) + '\nexit=' + str(p.returncode)
                   + '\nSTDOUT:\n' + p.stdout + '\nSTDERR:\n' + p.stderr)
    return p


def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    ap.add_argument('--source-root', required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--output-dir', required=True, type=Path)
    ap.add_argument('--peer-fastmath-file', type=Path,
                    help='Exact PR28 repair, used in throwaway ASan/UBSan projections only')
    ap.add_argument('--skip-benchmark', action='store_true')
    a = ap.parse_args()
    root = a.source_root.resolve()
    out = a.output_dir.resolve()
    if out.exists():
        ap.error('refusing to replace existing output or evidence')
    src = (root / SOURCE).read_bytes()
    if blob(src) != CHANGED_BLOB:
        raise ValueError(f'wrong current source blob {blob(src)}, expected {CHANGED_BLOB}')
    changed = src.decode('utf-8')
    if changed.count(INSERTED) != 1:
        raise ValueError('unexpected checkpoint-fast-path edit')
    parent = changed.replace(INSERTED, '', 1).encode('utf-8')
    if blob(parent) != PARENT_BLOB:
        raise ValueError('old source reconstruction does not match actual Git parent')
    for p, expected in PINS.items():
        got = blob((root / p).read_bytes())
        if got != expected:
            raise ValueError(f'wrong input {p}: {got} != {expected}')
    bench_bytes = (root / BENCH).read_bytes()
    if b'bank_seek_reverse(v,&b->bank[0],p,' not in bench_bytes:
        raise ValueError('benchmark does not call the real BREAK seek helper')
    peer = None
    if a.peer_fastmath_file:
        peer = a.peer_fastmath_file.read_bytes()
        if blob(peer) != PR28_HEADER:
            raise ValueError('the sanitizer projection is not the exact PR28 repair')
    out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=False)
    result = {'scope': 'PRODUCER HOST TEST; NOT independent QA, MCU deadline, model build, or device PASS',
              'before_source_blob': PARENT_BLOB, 'after_source_blob': CHANGED_BLOB,
              'unchanged_blobs': PINS, 'microbench_blob': blob(bench_bytes),
              'peer_PR28_sanitizer_projection': PR28_HEADER if peer is not None else 'NOT_RUN',
              'tests': [], 'microbench': [], 'outstanding': {
                 'owner_Elite_Pro_controller_compilation': 'NOT_RUN', 'independent_full_root_QA': 'NOT_RUN',
                 'original_source_UBSan': 'INHERITED FAIL (fastmath.h:57, existing PR28 owner)',
                 'device_ISR': 'NOT_RUN', 'hardware': 'NOT_RUN'}}
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='x0x-aligned-seek-') as t:
        tmp = Path(t)
        variants = {}
        for kind, source in (('before', parent), ('after', src)):
            folder = tmp / kind
            variants[kind] = folder
            for path in PINS:
                dest = folder / path
                dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                shutil.copyfile(root / path, dest)
            dest = folder / SOURCE
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(source)
            dest = folder / BENCH
            dest.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            dest.write_bytes(bench_bytes)
        fixtures = [('fast-reverse', 'tests/host/breaks_reverse_fast_advance_test.c',
                     ['--check', '--trace'], 5*2*7*2, 5*2*7*2*8*64*4),
                    ('live-stress', 'tests/host/breaks_live_stress_test.c',
                     [], 16, 16*320*64*4)]
        for compiler in ('gcc', 'clang'):
            for flags, label in ((['-O2'], 'opt'),
                                 (['-O1', '-g', '-fno-omit-frame-pointer',
                                   '-fsanitize=address,undefined'], 'san_projection') if peer else ([], 'not_run')):
                if not flags:
                    continue
                rows = {}
                for kind in ('before', 'after'):
                    folder = variants[kind]
                    if label == 'san_projection':
                        (folder / 'firmware/src/dsp/fastmath.h').write_bytes(peer)
                    for label_test, fixture, args, cases, pcm_length in fixtures:
                        exe = folder / (compiler+'-'+label+'-'+label_test)
                        base_cmd = [compiler, '-std=c11', '-Wall', '-Wextra', '-Werror',
                                    '-pedantic', '-ffp-contract=off', '-I'+str(folder)] + flags
                        cmd = base_cmd + [str(folder / fixture), str(folder / SOURCE), '-lm', '-o', str(exe)]
                        prefix = f'{compiler}-{label}-{label_test}-{kind}'
                        comp_log = out / (prefix+'.compile.log')
                        comp = run(cmd, comp_log)
                        if comp.returncode:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'{prefix} compilation failed: {comp.returncode}')
                        pcm = folder / (prefix+'.pcm')
                        cmd = [str(exe)] + args + [str(pcm)]
                        env = os.environ.copy()
                        if label == 'san_projection':
                            env.update(ASAN_OPTIONS='detect_leaks=1:abort_on_error=1',
                                       UBSAN_OPTIONS='halt_on_error=1:print_stacktrace=1')
                        r = run(cmd, out / (prefix+'.run.log'), env=env)
                        if r.returncode:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'{prefix} execution failed: {r.returncode}')
                        if pcm.stat().st_size != pcm_length:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'{prefix} trace length mismatch: {pcm.stat().st_size}')
                        lines = [s for s in r.stdout.splitlines() if s.startswith('n=')]
                        if len(lines) != cases or len(set(lines)) != cases:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'{prefix} scenario count mismatch')
                        if any('silent=0' in s or 'stopped=0' in s or 'audible=0' in s for s in lines):
                            raise RuntimeError(f'{prefix} silence/audibility control failed')
                        bad = run([str(exe)], out / (prefix+'.negative.log'), env=env)
                        if bad.returncode != 2:
                            raise RuntimeError(f'{prefix} invalid argument not rejected')
                        rows[(kind,label_test)] = (sha(pcm.read_bytes()), r.stdout)
                        result['tests'].append({'config':prefix,'compile_exit':0,'render_exit':0,
                            'negative_exit':2, 'scenarios':cases, 'pcm_bytes':pcm_length,
                            'pcm_sha256':rows[(kind,label_test)][0],
                            'compile_log_sha256':sha(comp_log.read_bytes())})
                        pcm.unlink()
                    # Restore original for optimized modes; never mutate tracked root.
                    if label == 'san_projection':
                        shutil.copyfile(root / 'firmware/src/dsp/fastmath.h',
                                        folder / 'firmware/src/dsp/fastmath.h')
                for label_test, *_ in fixtures:
                    if rows[('before',label_test)] != rows[('after',label_test)]:
                        raise RuntimeError(f'{compiler} {label} not bit-identical PCM and controls: {label_test}')
        if not a.skip_benchmark:
            for compiler in ('gcc','clang'):
                for kind in ('before','after'):
                    folder = variants[kind]
                    cmd = [compiler, '-std=c11','-O2','-Wall','-Wextra','-Werror',
                           '-pedantic','-ffp-contract=off','-I'+str(folder),
                           str(folder / BENCH), '-lm','-o',str(folder/(compiler+'-bench'))]
                    r = run(cmd, out / (compiler+'-bench-'+kind+'.compile.log'))
                    if r.returncode:
                        raise RuntimeError(f'microbench failed compile: {compiler} {kind}')
                for length in (65535,176400):
                    times = {'before': [], 'after': []}
                    checksums = {'before': [], 'after': []}
                    for trial in range(9):
                        kinds = ('before','after') if trial%2==0 else ('after','before')
                        for kind in kinds:
                            exe = variants[kind] / (compiler+'-bench')
                            start = time.perf_counter_ns()
                            p = subprocess.run([str(exe), str(length)], capture_output=True, text=True,
                                               check=False, timeout=90)
                            elapsed = (time.perf_counter_ns()-start)/1e6
                            if p.returncode or not p.stdout.startswith(f'length={length} '):
                                raise RuntimeError('benchmark failed actual seek path')
                            times[kind].append(round(elapsed,6))
                            checksums[kind].append(p.stdout.strip())
                        if checksums['before'][-1] != checksums['after'][-1]:
                            raise RuntimeError('real seek helper state/algorithm mismatch')
                    bm = statistics.median(times['before']); am = statistics.median(times['after'])
                    result['microbench'].append({'compiler':compiler, 'length':length,
                        'calls_per_trial':25000000, 'median_before_ms':round(bm,4),
                        'median_after_ms':round(am,4), 'change_percent':round(100*(am-bm)/bm,3),
                        'raw_elapsed_ms':times, 'exact_state_checksum':checksums['before'][0],
                        'note':'host process elapsed; noisy; not complete callback or target-cycle speed'})
    result['disposition'] = 'PRODUCER HOST PCM/controls matched; target budgets and independent QA pending'
    (out / 'result.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,sort_keys=True,indent=2)+'\n')
    print('PASS: source-blob verified, GCC/Clang renderer PCM and NoteOff/STOP parity')
    for b in result['microbench']:
